name: API Data Connector
description: Connects APIs to fields with autocomplete features.
project_description:
The External API Autocomplete Field module enhances the user experience in Drupal by providing a dynamic autocomplete feature for fields that fetch data from an external API. This module allows site builders and developers to easily integrate external data sources into their forms, enabling users to find and select options as they type quickly.

 Features 
 Customizable API Integration: Administrators can configure the API endpoint, request parameters, and response handling to suit their specific needs.

 Post-Installation 
 Navigate to the field settings where you want to use the API Data Connector widget.

Select API Data Connector Widget as the field widget.

Configure the widget settings to specify the API URL and other parameters.
